baseline.note: Eight-job green technical framework CI: 99 API xUnit, 26 live SQL/Redis/Wolverine tests, 7 native backup/restore and safety drills, 8 real SIGKILL fault drills on both PostgreSQL and SQL Server including pre-ACK redelivery with one idempotent effect, signed offline HMAC checkpoint verification, NuGet/SPDX, Trivy OCI security, Keycloak OIDC, non-root container and signed package provenance. Later changes must pass their own CI.
